title: Cross-layer silent-loss evidence: exact identity, LEADER fields, and ACIS carriers
mode: Primary-source web research plus read-only local source/test/plan cross-check
baselineQualification: The shared worktree was already broadly dirty. Local observations refer to the shared worktree and do not claim a clean-checkout baseline.
scope: Reconcile ACadSharp's AC1032 missing-INSERT report with its aggregate-type count confound and libdxfrw's inheritance hierarchy.
Trace ACadSharp's LEADER text-width report through the Autodesk DXF contract, ezdxf's rendering path, and local generated controls.
Keep GDAL's documented LEADER OCS limitation and LibreDWG's ACIS/ACDS carrier-loss report distinct from local semantic and identity claims.
Update the existing implementation checkpoints with a bounded semantic probe and evidence separation, without adding findings or top-level subplans.

method.kind: Current primary-source web review and read-only local source/test/plan inspection
method.limitations: ACadSharp #1172 and #1180 rely on private DWG inputs and have not been independently reproduced. ezdxf source describes one projection implementation, not a universal CAD rendering rule. GDAL's documented OCS limitation prevents its projected geometry from serving as a LEADER semantic oracle. LibreDWG #1411 is reporter-attributed peer evidence. No external artifact or application was run.

sources.revision: Issue bodies and visible discussion reviewed 2026-10-19.
sources.observed: #1172 remains an open private-input AC1032 missing-INSERT report. A commenter identifies a possible aggregate-count confound because TableEntity derives from Insert and separately references #1001, but the comment does not explain the original no-notification symptom. #1180 reports zero text width/height for annotated LEADERs in ACadSharp 3.6.51, group 41 zero, and missing hook geometry in downstream rendering; no drawing is attached.

The reference assigns groups 40/41 to annotation height/width, group 73 to annotation creation type, groups 74/75 to hook direction/presence, and group 340 to the associated annotation. It does not prescribe a renderer's exact hook-segment algorithm.

sources.revision: Mutable master source fetched 2026-10-19; no immutable commit was bound and no code was run.
sources.observed: virtual_entities() reads text_width and horizontal_direction; for text annotation with a hook, it reverses the horizontal vector when hookline_direction is 1 and adds a hook only when dimtad is nonzero and text_width is positive. Its endpoint extension uses dimgap * dimscale + text_width. This is an implementation-specific projection suitable for a pinned comparator probe, not normative universal behavior.

sources.revision: Current online driver documentation and known-issues ledger reviewed 2026-10-19.
sources.observed: GDAL documents that 3D/OCS support is absent for DIMENSION, LEADER, and MULTILEADER projection paths. Its output must not decide LEADER OCS semantic correctness.

sources.revision: Open issue body reviewed 2026-10-19; no linked drawing was downloaded.
sources.observed: The reporter describes a synthetic R2018 DXF→DWG→DXF reproduction in which REGION records survive while a 5489-byte SAB body is lost, plus a private real DWG with 88 REGIONs and an ACDSDATA-related loss report. These observations support separating record, carrier, owner, and semantic accounting; they do not establish local behavior.

DRW_Table derives from DRW_Insert. DRW_Leader has fields for textheight/textwidth; its DWG parser fills them in a version-gated body branch, and the DXF writer emits groups 40 and 41. Existing generated controls assert LEADER field values, annotation-reference identity, record order, and following-record alignment. They do not run an independent renderer or qualify native-producer values/geometry.

existingOwnersRetained: LEADER generated field and cursor-alignment controls
PAR-59/PAR-07 modeler carrier and owner accounting
rules: Partition source-to-output counts by exact entity type, identity/handle, owner path and disposition; inheritance totals are secondary only.
At the composed LEADER checkpoint, generate a planar DXF control with explicit dimension-style values and derive the expected hook endpoint analytically from source-authored inputs.
Pin the ezdxf revision and record target DXF version, exact tags, input/output hashes, and ordered projected segment endpoints; include zero-width, hook-disabled, and non-text-annotation negatives.
Treat a local-writer-generated DWG as structural path coverage, not an independent producer witness; keep external/native qualification separate and do not commit external files.
Exclude GDAL LEADER/MULTILEADER OCS geometry from semantic denominators.
For modeler records, require separate entity, carrier, owner/reference, explicit disposition, and geometry-semantic observations.
